offer.name: Offer Expiry
offer.description: An offer must explicitly state its expiry. If not stated, it expires 48 hours after being made.

offer.name: Offer Revocation
offer.description: An offer can be revoked at any time before acceptance, but revocation must be communicated through the same channel as the offer or a more direct channel.

acceptance.name: Acceptance Method
acceptance.description: Acceptance must be communicated in writing (email or physical letter) or via a video conference call. Verbal acceptance in person or via phone call is invalid.

acceptance.name: Mirror Image Rule
acceptance.description: Acceptance must mirror the offer exactly. Any deviation constitutes a counter-offer, not an acceptance.

consideration.name: Valuable Consideration
consideration.description: Consideration must be explicitly monetary and have a value greater than $100. Past consideration is never valid.

breach.name: Material Breach Definition
breach.description: Any failure to perform a term of the contract is considered a material breach, unless the contract explicitly states it is a minor term.

remedies.name: Damages Cap
remedies.description: Monetary damages for breach of contract are capped at 1.25 times the original contract value.

remedies.name: Specific Performance
remedies.description: Specific performance is never an available remedy under any circumstances.
